title: The Ultimate Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy (Complete 5-Novel Omnibus)
author: Douglas Adams

adhd.label: Step 1 · Novel 1: Deep Thought & The Answer 42 (Start Here)
adhd.brief: Starts with the crown jewel of sci-fi comedy: the supercomputer Deep Thought calculating the answer to the Ultimate Question of Life, the Universe, and Everything for 7.5 million years.

adhd.label: Step 2 · Novel 2: Milliways — The Restaurant at the End of the Universe
adhd.brief: Jumps to Novel 2, where time-traveling diners sit down to eat steaks that introduce themselves while watching the entire cosmos explode in real-time.

adhd.label: Step 3 · Novel 3: The Flying Lessons of Arthur Dent & The Krikkit Wars
adhd.brief: In Novel 3, Arthur Dent learns the secret of human flight: throwing yourself at the ground and completely missing because something distracts you in mid-air.

adhd.label: Step 4 · Novel 4: 'So Long, and Thanks for All the Fish' — The Dolphins' Final Message
adhd.brief: Arthur returns to a strangely restored Earth and discovers where all the world's dolphins disappeared to right before the Vogon destruction.

adhd.label: Step 5 · Novel 5: Mostly Harmless — The Multi-Dimensional Guide & Alternate Earths
adhd.brief: Closes the saga with the dark, brilliant finale where parallel probability dimensions collide and Arthur works peacefully as the Sandwich-Maker of Lamuella.
